sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: RFID keycard with unknown name (RFID L.) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A personalized RFID card with a strict design. An exact copy of Kruglov's keycard, but the owner's name has been deliberately scrubbed off. Grants access to the TerraGroup evacuation point reserved for trusted personnel.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market, be sold to traders or destroyed.
- This item is not lootable from players and can only be placed in a special item slot.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in the story chapter The Ticket if the player sided with Lightkeeper.
